name: Intuit QuickBooks
summary: QuickBooks business insights and actions: financial health briefings across P&L, cash flow, balance sheet and A/R, industry benchmarking, payroll cost analysis, overdue-invoice reminders, estimate/invoice drafting from email, payroll onboarding and base-pay changes (with confirmation), and QuickBooks Capital lending guidance. Requires the Intuit QuickBooks connector.
